create_tensorboard_writer: create a TensorboardWriter instance with a log directory, logger, and enabled flag for experiment logging
set_tensorboard_step: set the training or validation step on a TensorboardWriter to track progress and compute steps per second
add_scalar_to_tensorboard: add a scalar value to Tensorboard using the TensorboardWriter proxy method with automatic tag and step handling
add_image_to_tensorboard: add an image to Tensorboard using the TensorboardWriter proxy method with automatic mode tag and step tracking
review_tensorboardwriter_getattr: review the TensorboardWriter __getattr__ method that proxies Tensorboard add_data calls with step and mode tag injection
